Subject: Vendor setup + sync on PO windows and invoice cutoffs

Hi David —

Thanks for getting StormGrid through the onboarding checklist last week. A couple of follow-ups from our AP team as we stand up the PO flow into our ERP:

1) Invoice timing — our standard payment runs hit on the 1st and 15th of each month. For Redwood to fall into the 15th cut, we need invoices submitted by the 5th.
2) PO reference — can you confirm the exact PO field Redwood will populate so our ingest maps correctly? (PO number + cost center required).
3) Net terms — legal is asking whether Redwood will accept Net 45 for this initial contract, with an option for early payment (Net 30 equivalent) if we enroll in your early-pay program.

I've attached our vendor onboarding form (blank) for any missing fields. Can we align on these by next Wed (11/4)?

Attachments: [StormGrid_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF, 180KB)]

Best,
Priya Singh
Vendor Operations
StormGrid Inc.

Subject: Re: Vendor setup + sync on PO windows and invoice cutoffs

Hi Priya —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers inline and a couple of asks for your AP team: 

1) Invoice timing: understood. We can target submission by the 5th to hit your 15th run. For month-end services, our billing system issues invoices on the 1st; for usage-based invoices we can optionally force an earlier cut if you flag the PO.

2) PO reference: Redwood will populate PO Number in the invoice header (field PO_NUMBER). We'll also include cost_center and project_code in the invoice line-item comments. I'll attach our PO template (filled sample) for your mapping team.

3) Net terms: We are comfortable with Net 45 for the starting term. We also run an early-pay program that gives a 1.5% discount for Net 30 settlement. If StormGrid elects early-pay, we can instruct finance to apply the discount and change payment SLA accordingly.

Action items: 
- Priya / AP: confirm whether you want Redwood to opt-in to early-pay for this account (we can enable a billing flag).
- Marissa: can you prepare a one-page AP intake (fields we require) and a sample invoice for their mapping?

Attachments: [Redwood_PO_Template_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB)]

Thanks,
David Kim
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

David / Ben —

I put together the AP intake we discussed and attached the sample invoice. Key notes for StormGrid mapping:
- Required header fields: invoice_date, invoice_number, PO_NUMBER (exact match), supplier_tax_id
- Line item expectations: description, qty, unit_price, project_code (optional)
- Cutoff behavior: if invoice_date <= 2026-11-05 -> included in 2026-11-15 payment run; otherwise next cycle

If StormGrid wants the early-pay option enabled, finance needs the vendor level consent (email from AP confirming opt-in). Early-pay terms we offer: 1.5% discount if paid at Net 30. We can record the discount as a separate credit line on the invoice to make reconciliation straightforward.
